messages:
maria: Heads-up team — Horizon onboarding tomorrow. demo went fine but NPS slid to 6 in last touch. want a low-risk prefilling plan + short warm pool for their import window. goal: avoid p99 spikes and capture 48h feedback.

ashok: What are their peak traffic patterns?

maria: Import job ~180 r/s to /batch/generate for ~12min (avg seq=280). chat baseline 7 r/s with bursts up to 58 r/s.

zoe: For that profile I recommend: 1) short prefix cache TTL=30s for repeated system prompts, 2) KV cache enabled for chat context, 3) batching.window_ms=45 with jitter=0.12 and max_batch_tokens=1400, 4) streaming_first_byte=true for chat so users see partial tokens early.

ashok: Sounds good. Any specific warm pool size?

maria: start with warm_workers=5 from -10m to +20m around import; increase to 8 if queue_depth > 60% for 2m.

zoe: fallback routing: if error_rate>3% OR queue_depth>80% for 3m then route to quantized_small and enable partial_streaming. also reduce batch.window_ms to 25ms temporarily.

maria: i'll add tags tenant:renewal_watch=true and survey_context=import_migration. we should also emit traces for prefill.started/completed, cache.hit_ratio, batch.latency.p95/p99, stream.first_byte_ms, fallback.triggered.

ashok: who runs the prefill? i can schedule but need the curl and rate limits to avoid hitting their origin ingress.

maria: paste below — use pref_rate to cap origin calls and stagger tenants if running multiple prefill jobs.
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/warmup \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RID" \
  -d '{"tenant":"horizon","routes":["/batch/generate","/chat"],"prefill_size":350,"prefill_rate":45}'
```

ops-bot: Warmup job created: job_id=wm-2027-06-12-horizon-01 run_at=4234569000

zoe: Observability checklist: emit metrics and logs: prefill.requested, prefill.completed, cache.hit_rate, batch.window_ms, batch.size_p50/95/99, stream.first_byte_ms, fallback.count. add dashboard widgets for prefill success and renewal tags.

maria: Alerting plan: 3m window alert if p99>1200ms OR error_rate>4% -> trigger routing rule (quantized_small) + notify #cs-oncall. include runbook link.

ashok: assigned tasks: @ashok schedule & monitor warmup, @zoe implement metric emits & dashboard, @maria prep 48h pulse and renewal playbook items.

cs-automation: 48h pulse template created: 2-question in-app widget (sentiment + quick comment). auto-create ticket if rating <=6 and tag priority=renewal.

ops-bot: Warmup job started: job_id=wm-2027-06-12-horizon-01 status=running

ops-bot: Warmup job completed: job_id=wm-2027-06-12-horizon-01 status=success duration=21s prefilled=347 routes=2

ashok: Initial metrics: cache.hit_rate=80%, batch.p95=320ms, stream.first_byte=105ms, no fallbacks triggered so far. leaving warm pool for +25m.

zoe: small tweak: if we see p95>500ms but p99 still under 1s, prefer increasing warm_workers by +2 instead of tuning batch.window_ms — helps steady throughput. we'll document this in the runbook.

maria: good note. i'll draft a short one-pager with the config snippets, alert thresholds, and the rollback steps for the CS playbook. posting link once ready.

ashok: will monitor and update if any anomalies. thanks team.

ops-bot: Warmup job ended: job_id=wm-2027-06-12-horizon-01 status=archived
